verdict.rationale: Datadog documents offline Experiments, where you create and version datasets and compare results, along with SDK and API evaluation submission. Nothing in the pack shows running these evals in a CI pipeline or blocking a deployment based on eval scores. The only documented CI gating blocks merges on code-coverage thresholds, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
